title: Owner accepts or rejects each gap-review proposal
goal: Owner accepts or rejects each gap-review proposal
acceptance: Each proposal is accepted or rejected
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: five proposals, each read at its evidence link, about 30 minutes. Not a measurement.
